clue.text: Is one in bed? Part of ear's given recurrent trouble

parts.note: the lobe is the soft fleshy part of the ear

indicators.note: recurrent suggests running back, so the word for trouble is read backwards

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: A puzzled query about someone in bed, then an earache that keeps coming back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recurrent' turns AIL into LIA. The definition plays on a flower bed, not a bed for sleeping.
explanation.definitionFit: This blue-flowered plant is a favourite for bedding out in garden borders, so it is one found in a bed.

clue.text: Building is to let — that's an understatement

indicators.note: building means putting together, so the letters of these words are constructed afresh

explanation.surface: Calling a construction site merely available for rent is putting it mildly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Building' looks like a noun about property, but it is the anagram signal on IS TO LET.
explanation.definitionFit: Litotes is the figure of speech that affirms by denying the opposite, as in 'not bad', a form of deliberate understatement.

clue.text: Trifle with beautiful woman toting a gun

indicators.note: toting means carrying, so the woman's word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful woman
gat is old American slang for a gun

explanation.surface: Flirting with a gorgeous woman who happens to be carrying a firearm.
explanation.definitionFit: A bagatelle is something of little importance, a mere trinket or triviality.

clue.text: Races in for card-game or numbers game

indicators.note: in tells us the races are placed inside the card game's name

parts.note: loo is an old card game
the TT, short for Tourist Trophy, is the motorcycle races on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Someone wondering whether to hurry off to cards or to bingo.
explanation.walkthrough: LOO is also a crossword's usual toilet, but here it is the card game.
explanation.definitionFit: This game is played by drawing numbered counters and covering matching numbers on a card, much like bingo.

clue.text: Assign property

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to credit or ascribe something to a cause or person
as a noun, a quality or characteristic

explanation.definitionFit: Stressed on the second syllable it means ascribe; stressed on the first it means a quality or feature.

clue.text: Opportunity to bug first drinking place

indicators.note: first places the word for bug at the front, ahead of the opportunity

parts.note: to tap a phone is to bug it
room, as in room for manoeuvre, is scope or opportunity

explanation.surface: A spy's chance to plant a listening device before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: A taproom is the bar of a pub or inn where beer is served from the tap.

clue.text: A conviction, whichever way one looks at it

indicators.text: whichever way one looks at it
indicators.note: says the word reads identically from either end, so the definition alone gives the letters

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A firmly held belief that looks the same from every angle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or belief held firmly, as in a doctrine of a faith.

clue.text: Device preventing leaves from scattering

parts.note: reads like garden kit stopping autumn leaves blowing away, but the leaves are sheets of paper held together by a small bent wire

explanation.definitionFit: This small loop of wire holds sheets of paper together, so the pages do not get separated.

clue.text: Admitted knight coming in was in debt

indicators.note: coming in says the knight's letter enters the word for being in debt

parts.note: to have owed is to have been in debt
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A confession that a knight who turned up was short of money.
explanation.definitionFit: To have owned up is to have admitted, as in 'she owned that she was wrong'.

clue.text: One interrupting Silas is a seaman'

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking in, so the numeral is placed inside the surname

parts.note: Silas Marner is the weaver in George Eliot's novel of that name
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone cutting into George Eliot's weaver, who turns out to be a sailor.
explanation.walkthrough: Silas is the given name; his surname MARNER is what the clue wants. The stray apostrophe after seaman is a print mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A mariner is a sailor, one who works on ships at sea.

clue.text: Garment almost too close-fitting

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: tights are a close-fitting garment for the legs

explanation.surface: A piece of clothing that is nearly too snug.
explanation.definitionFit: Shoes or clothes described this way are uncomfortably small and constricting.

clue.text: It takes the lid off money available to the queen

parts.note: tin is old slang for money
open means accessible or available
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A royal windfall that exposes something by lifting its cover.
explanation.definitionFit: This kitchen gadget cuts round the top of a can to remove its lid.

clue.text: One who makes an indelible impression on people

definitions.text: One who makes an indelible impression on people

parts.words: One who makes an indelible impression on people
parts.note: reads as someone memorable, but literally describes an artist who marks permanent designs into the skin

explanation.definitionFit: This craftsperson inks designs into skin that cannot be washed off, a literally lasting mark on clients.

clue.text: Radioactive gas caused fuss in the Navy

indicators.note: in places the fuss inside the navy's abbreviation

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy
ado means fuss or bother

explanation.surface: A leak of dangerous gas causes a commotion aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Radon is a heavy radioactive element, a noble gas formed when radium decays.

clue.text: Concession about a Lad's introduction in Shropshire once

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the concession's letters go round the rest

parts.note: a sop is something given to placate, a concession

indicators.note: introduction means the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A small allowance made for a young man's first appearance in an English county.
explanation.walkthrough: SALOP is the old official name for Shropshire, an English county on the Welsh border; A E Housman's A Shropshire Lad lies behind the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The county was officially renamed to this abbreviation-based form between 1974 and 1980, hence 'once'.

clue.text: Carrier available' for a small charge

definitions.text: Carrier available' for a small charge

parts.words: Carrier available' for a small charge
parts.note: reads like a delivery service offered cheaply, but the small charge is a little child in one's care, wheeled about in a folding seat

explanation.walkthrough: The stray apostrophe after available is a print mark.
explanation.definitionFit: This folding seat on wheels carries a toddler, a young person in someone's keeping.

clue.text: Cushion the effects of long sittings

definitions.text: Cushion the effects of long sittings

parts.words: Cushion the effects of long sittings
parts.note: sounds like easing the strain of marathon meetings, but literally means padding chairs so long periods seated hurt less

explanation.definitionFit: To pad and cover seats with fabric and stuffing makes long spells of sitting comfortable.

clue.text: Having a high temperature preceded rash

parts.note: hot means having a high temperature
headed, as in headed the procession, means went before

explanation.surface: A feverish patient was first to come out in spots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rash' tempts as the skin complaint that goes with a fever; it is the adjective meaning reckless.
explanation.definitionFit: Being impetuous or quick-tempered is the same as acting without thought.

clue.text: One who may declare in match providing that's right

parts.note: a Test is an international cricket match
if means providing, on condition that
ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A cricket captain who might declare during a Test, on the condition that it is correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'declare' plays on a cricket captain closing the innings; here it means state formally, as a witness does.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who gives evidence makes a solemn statement, often in court.

clue.text: Maidens perhaps shut up, having been extravagant

parts.note: in cricket a maiden is an over with no runs scored, so maidens are examples of overs
pent, as in pent-up, means shut in

explanation.surface: Young women confined indoors after a shopping spree.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden over in cricket is a set of six balls from which no runs are scored.
explanation.definitionFit: To have spent too much money is to have been lavish or wasteful.

clue.text: Away team is ahead of the ball

parts.note: off means away, as in going off
a side is a team

explanation.surface: The visiting players have got in front of play.
explanation.definitionFit: In football or rugby a player is penalised for being in an illegal position in front of the ball.

clue.text: Attitudes taken by half-hearted sheriffs' men

indicators.note: half-hearted means part of the word's heart is lost, here one of its two central letters

parts.note: a posse is a group of men summoned by a sheriff

explanation.surface: Lukewarm deputies adopt certain stances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-hearted' removes one of the two middle S's of POSSES.
explanation.definitionFit: Poses are postures or stances adopted, often for effect.

clue.text: Ann Page's suitor is inadequate

definitions.meaning: in Shakespeare's The Merry Wives of Windsor
meagre or scanty, as in slim resources

explanation.definitionFit: The Shakespeare character's name is also an adjective for meagre, as in a slight margin.

clue.text: Money king's left a composer

indicators.note: left means gone away, so the king's letter departs from the composer's name

parts.note: César Franck was a Belgian-born French composer
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Cash from a royal estate bequeathed to a musician.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'king's left' as 'king has left': K is removed from the name.
explanation.definitionFit: The franc was the currency unit of France, Belgium and Switzerland.

clue.text: Financial backer's viewpoint finally raised

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means moved upward, so the final letter climbs one place

parts.note: an angle is a point of view or approach

explanation.surface: An investor's opinion has at last been put forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally raised' lifts the last letter E above the L in the down entry, so ANGLE becomes ANGEL.
explanation.definitionFit: An investor who funds a theatrical production or new business is known by this heavenly title.

clue.text: Money row in food queue

parts.note: bread is slang for money
a line is a row

explanation.surface: An argument over cash among people waiting for a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' looks like a quarrel; it is a line.
explanation.definitionFit: A line of poor people waiting for charitable handouts of food; also the level of bare subsistence.

clue.text: Material dug up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: mined means dug

explanation.surface: Fabric unearthed in an excavation.
explanation.definitionFit: Denim is a hard-wearing twill cotton fabric, used for jeans.

clue.text: Constitutional change for Nigerian democratic leader

indicators.note: change for signals the national adjective is to be rearranged
leader means the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: Reform of the constitution on behalf of an African head of a democracy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constitutional' looks political, but it means inborn, part of one's constitution.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deep-rooted and inborn is part of one's nature or makeup.

clue.text: Nymph errant, Diana

indicators.note: errant means wandering astray, so the goddess's name is rearranged

explanation.surface: A water spirit and the wandering huntress goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: A naiad is a water nymph of rivers and springs in Greek myth.

clue.text: More modest legal objection — less resistance?

indicators.note: less means minus, so the resistance letter is removed

parts.note: a demurrer is a pleading that admits facts but objects that they give no legal claim
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A lawyer's challenge with less fight in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Demure means modest and reserved, so the comparative is more retiring.
